verdict.rationale: Proa ships compile-time-checked props and template validation, editor tooling such as hover, completion and rename, and an AGENTS.md file that gives agents validation commands. None of this is documented AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors. These are adjacent building blocks for an external agent, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native developer, I can use AI tooling that automatically resolves type errors surfaced by the framework's type system
